title: Antigravity System One Config
description: Configuration schema for agy-smart TypeSafe Jev skill router

threshold.description: Minimum Noul probability required to load a skill (0.05 to 0.95)

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for TypeSafe Jev API request before fallback (200 to 10000ms)

maxSkills.description: Maximum number of specialized skills loaded into session context (1 to 20)

verbose.description: Enable verbose CLI probability visualization in terminal output

skillWeights.description: Per-skill sensitivity multipliers (0.1 to 2.0x) to boost or dampen specific skills
